question: Mona writes about an ocean that separates North America from Europe. Which ocean is it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Atlantic Ocean is located between North and South America and also between Europe and Africa.**

 
 
• It is the second-largest ocean and has a depth of about 12000 ft.
 
 
 
• **It separates Africa from South America and North America from Europe. Hence option 1 is correct.**
 
• **Mediterranean Sea, Caribbean Sea, Gulf of Mexico, Hudson Bay, Labrador Sea etc are some of the biggest seas in the Atlantic Ocean.**
 
• Europe comprises of peninsula of Eurasia in the Northern Hemisphere and shares its landmass with both Asia and Africa.
 
 
• **The Ural mountains separate Europe from Asia. **
 
 
 
• North America lies in the Northern Hemisphere and completely in the Western Hemisphere bordered by the Arctic Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and shallowest Ocean in the world and is the coldest ocean of all. **

 
 
• It is surrounded by Eurasia and North America and also Bering Strait.
 
 
 
• **The Indian Ocean is the world's third-largest ocean** surrounded by Asia, Africa and Australia.
 
 
• Many major seas like the Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea, and Andaman Sea drain into the Indan Ocean.
 
 
 
• **The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean in the world** which extends from the Arctic Ocean to Antarctica.
 
 
• **The deepest location on Earth, the Mariana Trench is located in the Pacific Ocean.**
